events.summary: First-cut entry for Cymbopogon citratus (Lemon Grass), drawn from Kew POWO, Missouri Botanical Garden, NCSU Extension, UF/IFAS Extension Nassau County, ASPCA Poison Control, and Wikipedia. Native range (southern India / Sri Lanka), culinary/medicinal history, propagation, and ASPCA toxicity to pets are well-sourced. Butterfly/pollinator value is modest and candid about the absence of documented host relationships. Confidence is high on all core facts; slight uncertainty on leaf-blade sharpness as a handling hazard and on the exact Florida introduction timeline.
